payload.token: uuid — the token of the instance that joins its open combat; when absent, the command's target is the token. It joins once: a token already in the combat is refused, and so is an instance with no open combat
payload.initiative: integer — a PC's initiative, the figure the DM entered, required for a PC and refused for an NPC: an NPC rolls a d20 and adds its DEX modifier (Initiative@1). The newcomer is ranked by initiative, then DEX, then a random draw, after every participant ranked before it; the participants it lands ahead of each move down one rank, a relative step on their own entries
